name: Meta Kuna

timeline.event: Building 1 and 2 look complete from outside, with all electrical and cooling equipment installed. Construction has started on 2 smaller buildings to the north. Meta announced the arrival of the first server rack the following week.

Building 1 and 2 are operational. The 2nd phase of an offsetting solar array goes online on May 31, 2026. Idaho Public Utilities Comission's approval for this start date notes that "[Meta]’s load is expected to increase so much that it…

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Meta Kuna: current power 152 MW; owner Meta.

explain: Meta Kuna is an operating AI data center in Kuna ID, ID, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 152 MW today and 198 MW when finished.
